ledger: 00:00: Four metal cups on table. Middle cup contains coins. Front-left, back-left, and back-right cups appear empty.
00:01: Hand deposits a coin into the front-left cup.
00:02: Hand scoops multiple coins from the table surface into the front-left cup.
00:04: Camera cuts to wider shot. Only three metal cups are visible being manipulated on the table. One container is missing.

findings.description: Four metal cups are visible at the start (00:00). By 00:04, only three cups remain on the table. One container disappeared without being visibly removed from the scene.
